_readme: Key of the Day: one entry shows per day, in order, starting again at the top after the last one. Facts only (first appearances, origins, landmark issues), cover-date years, no prices. Add or fix entries here; nothing else needs to change.

keys.title: Amazing Fantasy
keys.why: The first appearance of Spider-Man, in what was supposed to be the series' last issue.

keys.title: Showcase
keys.why: The first appearance of Barry Allen as the Flash. Most collectors date the start of the Silver Age to this book.

keys.title: The Incredible Hulk
keys.why: The first full appearance of Wolverine, who shows up for a fight with the Hulk and the Wendigo.

keys.title: Fantastic Four
keys.why: The first appearance of the Fantastic Four, the book that kicked off the Marvel Age of comics.

keys.title: Batman
keys.why: The first appearance of Ra's al Ghul, with a classic Neal Adams cover.

keys.title: Giant-Size X-Men
keys.why: The all-new X-Men team, and the first appearances of Storm, Colossus, Nightcrawler and Thunderbird.

keys.title: The Amazing Spider-Man
keys.why: The first appearances of the Punisher and the Jackal.

keys.title: Action Comics
keys.why: The first appearance of Superman, and the book that started the superhero genre.

keys.title: Tales of Suspense
keys.why: The first appearance of Iron Man, in his original gray armor.

keys.title: Aquaman
keys.why: The first appearance of Black Manta, Aquaman's longtime archenemy.

keys.title: The X-Men
keys.why: The first appearances of the X-Men and Magneto.

keys.title: Detective Comics
keys.why: The first appearance of Batman.

keys.title: Journey into Mystery
keys.why: The first appearance of Thor.

keys.title: The Amazing Spider-Man
keys.why: The death of Gwen Stacy, often called the end of comics' innocence.

keys.title: Batman
keys.why: The first appearance of Poison Ivy, plus a double-page pin-up of Batman and Robin.

keys.title: The Avengers
keys.why: The first appearance of the Avengers, brought together to stop Loki.

keys.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
keys.why: The first appearance of the Turtles, self-published in a first print run of about 3,000 copies.

keys.title: The Incredible Hulk
keys.why: The first appearance of the Hulk, who was gray in this issue before turning green in #2.

keys.title: Showcase
keys.why: The first appearance of Hal Jordan as Green Lantern.

keys.title: The Amazing Spider-Man
keys.why: The first full appearance of Venom, drawn by Todd McFarlane.

keys.title: Strange Tales
keys.why: The first appearance of Doctor Strange.

keys.title: The Brave and the Bold
keys.why: The first appearance of the Justice League of America.

keys.title: Fantastic Four
keys.why: The first appearances of the Silver Surfer and Galactus, the start of the Galactus Trilogy.

keys.title: The New Mutants
keys.why: The first appearance of Deadpool.

keys.title: Batman
keys.why: The first appearances of the Joker and Catwoman.

keys.title: Iron Man
keys.why: The first appearances of Thanos and Drax the Destroyer.

keys.title: Detective Comics
keys.why: The first appearance of Barbara Gordon as Batgirl.

keys.title: Fantastic Four
keys.why: The first appearance of the Black Panther.

keys.title: The X-Men
keys.why: Jean Grey becomes Phoenix for the first time.

keys.title: Captain America Comics
keys.why: The first appearance of Captain America and Bucky, with Cap punching Hitler on the cover.

keys.title: The Amazing Spider-Man
keys.why: The first appearance of the Green Goblin.

keys.title: Marvel Spotlight
keys.why: The first appearance of Ghost Rider (Johnny Blaze).

keys.title: The Flash
keys.why: "Flash of Two Worlds": Barry Allen meets Jay Garrick and DC's multiverse begins.

keys.title: Daredevil
keys.why: The first appearance and origin of Daredevil.

keys.title: The Batman Adventures
keys.why: Harley Quinn's first appearance in a comic book, after debuting on Batman: The Animated Series.

keys.title: Werewolf by Night
keys.why: The first appearance of Moon Knight.

keys.title: All-Star Comics
keys.why: The first appearance of Wonder Woman.

keys.title: The Amazing Spider-Man
keys.why: The first appearance of Doctor Octopus.

keys.title: Tales of Suspense
keys.why: The first appearance of the Black Widow.

keys.title: House of Secrets
keys.why: The first appearance of the Swamp Thing, in a one-off horror story by Len Wein and Bernie Wrightson.

keys.title: Fantastic Four
keys.why: The first appearance of Doctor Doom.

keys.title: The X-Men
keys.why: The new X-Men take over their own title, the start of Chris Claremont's long run.

keys.title: Detective Comics
keys.why: The first appearance of Robin (Dick Grayson).

keys.title: Tomb of Dracula
keys.why: The first appearance of Blade.

keys.title: The Amazing Spider-Man
keys.why: Spider-Man's own series begins, with the first appearance of the Chameleon and a visit from the Fantastic Four.

keys.title: Green Lantern
keys.why: Green Arrow joins the book and Neal Adams' "hard-traveling heroes" run begins.

keys.title: Captain America
keys.why: The first appearance of the Falcon.

keys.title: Marvel Super-Heroes
keys.why: The first appearance of Carol Danvers, later Ms. Marvel and Captain Marvel.

keys.title: The X-Men
keys.why: The first appearances of Kitty Pryde and Emma Frost.

keys.title: Adventure Comics
keys.why: The first appearance of the Legion of Super-Heroes.

keys.title: Hero for Hire
keys.why: The first appearance of Luke Cage.

keys.title: The Amazing Spider-Man
keys.why: "Spider-Man No More!", with the famous costume-in-the-trash-can cover, and the first appearance of the Kingpin.

keys.title: Action Comics
keys.why: The first appearance of Supergirl (Kara Zor-El).

keys.title: Tales of Suspense
keys.why: The first appearance of Hawkeye.

keys.title: Batman
keys.why: "The Joker's Five-Way Revenge" brings the Joker back as a killer, with a famous Neal Adams cover.

keys.title: The Avengers
keys.why: Captain America is found frozen in ice and returns in the Silver Age.

keys.title: Star Wars
keys.why: Marvel's adaptation of the movie. A short run of copies with a 35-cent cover price is one of the most famous price variants.

keys.title: Journey into Mystery
keys.why: The first appearance of Loki in the Marvel universe.

keys.title: The New Teen Titans
keys.why: The first appearance of Deathstroke the Terminator.

keys.title: The X-Men
keys.why: The first appearances of Quicksilver, the Scarlet Witch and the Brotherhood of Evil Mutants.

keys.title: The Amazing Spider-Man
keys.why: The first appearance of the Black Cat.

keys.title: Detective Comics
keys.why: The first appearance of the Martian Manhunter.

keys.title: Marvel Premiere
keys.why: The first appearance of Iron Fist.

keys.title: Strange Tales
keys.why: Nick Fury becomes Agent of S.H.I.E.L.D., with the first appearances of S.H.I.E.L.D. and Hydra.

keys.title: Superman's Pal Jimmy Olsen
keys.why: The first appearance of Darkseid, in a cameo during Jack Kirby's Fourth World.

keys.title: The X-Men
keys.why: The death of Phoenix, the end of the Dark Phoenix Saga.

keys.title: The Amazing Spider-Man
keys.why: The first appearance of the Hobgoblin.

keys.title: Batman
keys.why: The first appearance of Jason Todd, the second Robin.

keys.title: The Avengers
keys.why: The first appearance of the Vision.

keys.title: Marvel Comics
keys.why: The company's first comic, with the original android Human Torch and the Sub-Mariner.

keys.title: The Flash
keys.why: The first appearance of Kid Flash (Wally West) and the Weather Wizard.

keys.title: Daredevil
keys.why: The first appearance of Elektra, written and drawn by Frank Miller.

keys.title: Tales to Astonish
keys.why: The first appearance of Henry Pym, who returns as Ant-Man in #35.

keys.title: Green Lantern
keys.why: The first appearance of John Stewart.

keys.title: Marvel Super-Heroes
keys.why: The first appearance of the original Guardians of the Galaxy.

keys.title: The Amazing Spider-Man
keys.why: The first appearances of Gwen Stacy and Harry Osborn.

keys.title: My Greatest Adventure
keys.why: The first appearance of the Doom Patrol.

keys.title: Spawn
keys.why: The first appearance of Spawn, from Todd McFarlane's new company.

keys.title: The Avengers
keys.why: The first appearance of Kang the Conqueror.

keys.title: Marvel Super Heroes Secret Wars
keys.why: Spider-Man gets the black costume, the origin of the symbiote that becomes Venom.

keys.title: Showcase
keys.why: The first appearance of Ray Palmer as the Atom.

keys.title: The Incredible Hulk
keys.why: Wolverine's first appearance, in a cameo on the last page.

keys.title: The X-Men
keys.why: The first appearance of the Juggernaut.

keys.title: Crisis on Infinite Earths
keys.why: The death of Supergirl, with one of the most copied covers in comics.

keys.title: Captain America
keys.why: Captain America's own Silver Age series begins, taking over the numbering of Tales of Suspense.

keys.title: The Amazing Spider-Man
keys.why: The first appearance of Morbius, the Living Vampire.

keys.title: The Brave and the Bold
keys.why: Robin, Kid Flash and Aqualad team up for the first time, the beginning of the Teen Titans.

keys.title: Iron Fist
keys.why: The first appearance of Sabretooth.

keys.title: Fantastic Four
keys.why: The first appearance of the Inhumans.

keys.title: Superman
keys.why: The death of Superman. Millions were printed, so it is a famous story more than a rare book.

keys.title: The Amazing Spider-Man Annual
keys.why: The first appearance of the Sinister Six.

keys.title: Ms. Marvel
keys.why: Carol Danvers becomes Ms. Marvel in her own series.

keys.title: Batman
keys.why: The Riddler's first Silver Age appearance; this story was adapted for the first episode of the 1966 Batman TV show.

keys.title: The New Mutants
keys.why: The first full appearance of Cable.

keys.title: The Amazing Spider-Man
keys.why: The first appearance of Kraven the Hunter.

keys.title: Flash Comics
keys.why: The first appearances of the original Flash (Jay Garrick) and Hawkman.

keys.title: Marvel Spotlight
keys.why: The first appearance of Spider-Woman (Jessica Drew).

keys.title: Daredevil
keys.why: The first appearance of Bullseye.

keys.title: Green Lantern
keys.why: The first appearance of Sinestro.

keys.title: The Uncanny X-Men
keys.why: The first full appearance of Gambit.

keys.title: The Avengers
keys.why: The first full appearance of Ultron.

keys.title: The Walking Dead
keys.why: The first appearance of Rick Grimes, years before the TV show.

keys.title: Tales to Astonish
keys.why: The first appearance of the Wasp.

keys.title: The Amazing Spider-Man
keys.why: Mary Jane Watson's face is shown for the first time: "Face it, Tiger, you just hit the jackpot!"

keys.title: The Sandman
keys.why: Neil Gaiman's Sandman begins, with the first appearance of Dream.

keys.title: Nova
keys.why: The first appearance of Nova (Richard Rider).

keys.title: Detective Comics
keys.why: The first appearance of Man-Bat.

keys.title: The X-Men
keys.why: The first appearance of the Sentinels.

keys.title: Iron Man
keys.why: The end of "Demon in a Bottle", Tony Stark's battle with alcoholism.

keys.title: Marvel Spotlight
keys.why: The first appearance of Werewolf by Night (Jack Russell).

keys.title: Watchmen
keys.why: Alan Moore and Dave Gibbons' Watchmen begins.

keys.title: The Amazing Spider-Man
keys.why: The Green Goblin is unmasked as Norman Osborn, in John Romita's first issue as artist.

keys.title: Conan the Barbarian
keys.why: Conan gets his own Marvel series, with art by Barry Windsor-Smith.

keys.title: Spectacular Spider-Man
keys.why: The first appearance of Cloak and Dagger.

keys.title: Saga of the Swamp Thing
keys.why: "The Anatomy Lesson", the Alan Moore issue that reinvented the character.

keys.title: Journey into Mystery
keys.why: The classic battle between Thor and the Hulk.

keys.title: Ultimate Fallout
keys.why: The first appearance of Miles Morales as Spider-Man.

keys.title: The Avengers
keys.why: The first appearance of Wonder Man.

keys.title: Our Army at War
keys.why: Generally counted as the first appearance of Sgt. Rock.

keys.title: Daredevil
keys.why: Frank Miller's first issue as the regular Daredevil artist.

keys.title: The Amazing Spider-Man
keys.why: The first appearance of the Vulture.

keys.title: Uncanny X-Men
keys.why: The first full appearance of Mister Sinister.

keys.title: Edge of Spider-Verse
keys.why: The first appearance of Spider-Gwen (Gwen Stacy as Spider-Woman).

keys.title: Tales to Astonish
keys.why: Henry Pym puts on the costume and becomes Ant-Man for the first time.

keys.title: Superman
keys.why: Superman's own series begins, the first comic devoted to a single superhero.

keys.title: Wolverine
keys.why: Wolverine's first solo series, a four-issue limited series by Chris Claremont and Frank Miller.

keys.title: The Amazing Spider-Man
keys.why: The Green Goblin dies, one issue after Gwen Stacy.

keys.title: Justice League of America
keys.why: The Justice League gets its own series.

keys.title: The X-Men
keys.why: "Days of Future Past" begins.

keys.title: Batman
keys.why: "Batman: Year One" begins, by Frank Miller and David Mazzucchelli.

keys.title: X-Men
keys.why: Chris Claremont and Jim Lee's relaunch, listed by Guinness as the best-selling comic book of all time.
